infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: AmpleCare records where you check in and out of a visit, so your agency can evidence that care was delivered. Your location is only read while the app is open.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Take photos as part of a visit record or an incident report.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Record a spoken care note instead of typing it.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Unlock AmpleCare without typing your password.
